content:
AP_NORTH delegates 500000 USD cents of executed payments per logical day and permits NORTH or COMMON obligations. AP_SOUTH delegates 400000 cents and permits SOUTH or COMMON.

An operator record identifies its limit_policy and beneficiary_scopes. Invitation acceptance and PAY activation are separate; PAY activation takes 30 minutes.

The daily capacity is consumed by principal actually executed under that approver, including payments still in processing. Approval without execution consumes no capacity.
